How to wear

One bandana,
five ways.

Not sure how to style it? Start with one of these.

Step-by-step guide

  1. 01

    Head

    Fold it into a triangle and tie it at the back of your head.

  2. 02

    Neck

    Tie a loose knot at the front. It lifts a plain t-shirt straight away.

  3. 03

    Wrist

    Roll it thin, wrap it twice and tuck in the ends.

  4. 04

    Bag

    Knot it around the strap or handle to add colour to any bag.

  5. 05

    Back pocket

    Let one corner hang out of your back pocket.
